sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण वाली प्रव्यथितो भृशम् ।न दोषम् राघवे दध्यौ धर्मे अधिगत निश्चयः ॥४-१८-४४॥
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa vālī pravyathito bhṛśam ।na doṣam rāghave dadhyau dharme adhigata niścayaḥ ॥4-18-44॥

translations.english: 'Seized with improper anger, you are reproaching one who is devoted to dharma, without knowing that I follow the code of conduct that has been passed on by my fathers and forefathers.'
